project.name: TruckConnect
project.description: Map all Socket.io events to Ably channels for enterprise-grade real-time functionality.

events.name: location_update
events.description: Sent when a driver updates their location; subscribed by nearby drivers.

events.name: voice_message_received
events.description: Emitted when a voice message is sent to a driver.

events.name: stress_signal_alert
events.description: Emitted to all nearby drivers when a stress signal is sent.

channels.name: friends
channels.purpose: Manage friend requests and real-time notifications

events.name: friend_request_received
events.description: Emitted to receiver when a friend request is sent.

events.name: friend_request_accepted
events.description: Emitted to sender when the friend request is accepted.

channels.notes: Replace Socket.io friend request emits and listeners.

tasks: Fetch JWT token asynchronously before connecting to Ably.
Use Ably Realtime SDK to connect with token.
Maintain type safety using Zod for incoming and outgoing messages.
Implement presence subscription on `drivers:locations` to track online/offline drivers.
Use Ably REST client to publish events on channels.
Validate payloads with Zod before publishing.
Replace all Socket.io server handlers (`update_location`, `send_voice_message`, `send_stress_signal`, `friend_request`) with Ably publish logic.
Maintain in-memory store only if needed for nearby drivers computations.
Ensure all channels use proper authentication and role validation.

migration_notes: Socket.io rooms are no longer needed; use Ably channels and presence instead.
Client reconnection and buffering should be handled by Ably SDK.
Nearby driver filtering can still use Haversine calculation based on latest location updates received.
Update frontend hooks (`useSocket`) to a new `useAbly` hook with async token fetch, publish queue, and typed events.
testing_plan: Verify multi-account nearby driver detection across devices.
Test voice messaging delivery and status updates.
Test stress signal alerts propagate to all nearby drivers.
Monitor Ably dashboard for latency, message delivery, and errors.
